svg.text: 2.0.0-alpha.2 + unreleased · 2026-08-28 · fux.index.v2 / analyzer v2 / fux.runtime.v5 · lexical only, no model anywhere
SOURCES — WHAT IS INDEXED, AND WHAT IS NOT · every one of these is a committed file
decides in BOTH directions — it beats
! RE-INCLUDES here; it subtracts next door
dirs · urls · types — one entry per line
loader-sorted, so order cannot leak in
a url line carries fetch=<name>; a dir line
doing its job. Nothing to fix.
could not read it. Maybe fixable.
INGEST — WALK, FETCH, DECODE, ANALYSE, RESOLVE EDGES, WRITE · then DISCARD the content
ingested 632 docs (32 changed, 600 carried forward), 341 not indexed, 1 skipped, 31 shards written
— and the same two words are written into .fuxignore
DECODE — BYTES BECOME MARKDOWN, IN ONE PLACE
setup copies them; THE COPY RUNS
pdf · docx · pptx · xlsx · odt · html · eml …
256 shards — blake2b(id, digest_size=1) · doc-major, one canonical JSON line per document · the header pins schema, analyzer and tf_fields
no prose · no floats · no nulls · no clocks · no vectors — the dense lane and its model were deleted 2026-08-25
Committed beside the index sources/ · fetchers/ · decoders/ · enrich/ · tune.toml · output.toml · .fuxignore
GITIGNORED IS THE TEST, NOT “.fux/”. .fux/runtime/ is the only derived directory under it — which is what keeps a use journal out of a commit.
THE DERIVED PLANE · .fux/runtime/ — gitignored, rebuilt by `fux build` in seconds
every result the accelerator returns is byte-identical to the reference scan.
Delete the derived plane and you lose speed, never an answer. That is what makes it disposable — and it is why a schema still versions it.
fetch live, compare sha, cite L12-L40
a byte budget, not a top-k
sha differs → mark dirty → narrowed re-ingest fixes ranking
THE LOOP THAT CLOSES THE GAP
refer used to compute the verdict and throw it away, so a changed URL kept its old terms, stopped ranking, was never cited, and
nothing noticed. It buys RECALL, not correctness: a changed document could never be mis-answered, only fail to surface. Only a
definitive url: staleness enters the list — file: changes are git's job, and post-commit already sees them.
WHAT THE ANSWER SAYS ABOUT ITSELF — CONFIDENCE AND PROVENANCE
the band ladder — first true wins
none nothing scored above 0, so abstain →
partial a term matches nothing, or the cited bytes
moved → weak separation below the floor → grounded
floors: separation 0.1 GATES · doc_coverage 0.0 is OFF
a floor is repo-local — it ships WITH the verdict
provenance — and only one flag writes
ask --why a second, untuned query: reachable →
window → placed → answered. Never instruments rank().
fux verify re-runs a receipt and never opens a socket → reproduced · drifted:config · drifted:corpus · unverifiable — config is checked before corpus.
TWO COMMITTED CONFIG FILES WITH OPPOSITE RULES — AND THE AGENT PORT
six tables: bm25f · ranking · graph · refer ·
Absent or empty = every default. No error.
never read on the maintenance path
An unset key is a FuxError naming the key.
MAINTENANCE AND THE AGENT SURFACE — written by `fux setup`, owned by the consumer, never rewritten
post-commit writes a dirty list and spawns a
detached one-shot runner — never a daemon
one write.lock · no hook opens a socket
ingest · build · add · remove · update take it;
fux daemon is a resident clock a human starts
write-if-missing; an edited file is never rewritten
fux → uv run fux → ./.venv/bin/fux → python -m fux
· probe with --version, cache per session, and never say “not installed”.
L1 stdlib only — threading is stdlib, so the pool costs nothing
L2 no durable content — the index holds statistics
L3 deterministic — the sort, not the loop
L4 offline by default — two named networked paths
L5 hashed meta by default for non-git sources
L8 a use record is never committed — plaintext is legal, a stdout receipt is legal, and “gitignored”, not “inside .fux/”, is the test
PROPOSED — SEARCH V3 · 2026-09-04 · NOTHING IN THIS BAND IS BUILT · work/proposals/search-v3.md · architecture-search-v3.svg

read from Node too — npx fux-search, zero deps, the same seven verbs over the same committed contract; python ≡ node as a third arm of the differential law · answer refers top-3, rescored with proximity
--expand / -q an agent-written expansion at a lower weight, RRF across phrasings · enrich → doc2query with a self-retrieval filter · declared tie-break · find --phrase/--under/--all
.fux/vectors/ (opt-in, pinned int8, agent-run embedder) read by --qvec, fused in rank space — gated on W-106 first · one portable log(), same idf bits on every libm and V8
